site.purpose: Help anonymous shoppers discover retail products, compare relevant attributes and fulfillment information, and assemble a cart for safe review.

baseline.timezone_policy: temporary deterministic default; no account or business timezone was directly observed

roles.changes: Can browse, search, inspect product and fulfillment information, and use the clone-local cart without an account.

core_journeys.purpose: Find a household or personal-care item and compare relevant result and option information.
steps: Review a populated result set and available filter/sort controls
Inspect and select a read-only option or variant
core_journeys.expected_result: The selected product detail reflects the chosen option and remains eligible for local cart use.
core_journeys.failure_variant: A query with no matching product shows a no-results state.
core_journeys.recovery_variant: Change the query or return through a recovery control to populated results.

core_journeys.purpose: Add one selected option to the offline cart and stop at a non-payment checkout review.
steps: Add the selected option to the local cart
Continue to the local checkout review boundary
core_journeys.expected_result: The review page shows the local item, fulfillment summary, subtotal, and no order/payment submission action.
core_journeys.failure_variant: Attempting to continue with an empty cart or missing required review data shows validation.
core_journeys.recovery_variant: Return to the product or cart, correct the state, and reopen review.
core_journeys.evidence_kind: first-party structural evidence plus unavailable source mutation semantics

core_journeys.purpose: Browse household and personal-care categories as an alternative to search.
core_journeys.expected_result: The category route exposes relevant products and returns safely to search or home.
core_journeys.failure_variant: A dynamic menu or category is unavailable.
core_journeys.recovery_variant: Use the all-departments or home recovery route.

entities: at least twelve products with prices, ratings, fulfillment labels and local images
at least two products with two or more options
one empty cart and one seeded restart-persistence probe
deterministic_seed_plan.reset_and_isolation: A deterministic reset restores the catalog and clears each actor's cart independently; refresh and restart preserve non-reset cart state.

external_services.clone_local_adapter: download approved in-scope assets with provenance; serve locally
full local catalog and deterministic search/filter model
no payment submission in frozen P0/P1; backend profile remains local-sandbox

requested_source_mutations: add one nonsensitive household or personal-care item to the Walmart source cart
navigate the resulting Walmart source cart to checkout review without submitting checkout

trace_candidates.agent_suggested_scope: Anonymous public product discovery covering a successful search, directly available filters or sort controls, one product detail, read-only options, and no-results recovery without a source cart mutation.
trace_candidates.why_needed: Current GET-only capture did not establish a populated result grid, product detail, exact option semantics, or mobile behavior.

trace_candidates.agent_suggested_scope: Source cart and checkout-review state sufficient to establish exact cart/review semantics, stopping before any checkout submission or payment.
trace_candidates.why_needed: Current authority prohibits the source mutation needed to reach cart and review states, so the local implementation would otherwise rely on structural evidence and a full local model.
uncertainty_resolved: checkout review fields and validation boundary

remaining_material_uncertainties: Populated search result and product-detail pixels/copy
Exact filter, sort and option state transitions

field_evidence.observation: Headed Playwright returned HTTP 200, the canonical URL, and the Walmart page title.
Document title and visible header copy identify Walmart.
An isolated context with no storage state rendered the public shopping shell and search controls.
The page rendered English text, U.S. service messaging and dollar prices; regional fulfillment was capture-dependent.
Official help establishes a cart-to-checkout concept, but source mutation and exact live semantics were not observed.
